name: flemo-agent-guidance
hypothesis: Portable flemo guidance improves first-pass implementation of unfamiliar compositions beyond declaration JSDoc alone.

primaryEndpoint.name: first-pass-behavioral-success
primaryEndpoint.definition: A production build scores at least 85 points and passes every critical criterion before any repair prompt.

scoring.evidence: Production typecheck and build pass without forbidden dependencies or mocks.
Local navigation changes only the contained stack; ancestor-targeted navigation changes only the app stack.
The header shell keeps stable geometry while its changing fields hand over on push, pop, swipe cancel, and swipe commit.
At equal screen displacement, programmatic pop and swipe place changing header fields at the same fraction of their paths.
The shared object and its repeated title travel as one identity without doubled glyphs, blur, or landing residue.
An overlay opened from contained content paints above outer shared chrome without changing either navigation stack.
No console errors, stuck navigation, duplicate active participants, or transition artifacts remain after landing.

stoppingRule.plannedRuns: Complete all 96 primary runs. There is no early efficacy stop.
stoppingRule.integrityPause: Pause only for a corpus, runner, provider outage, or scoring defect discovered before treatment labels are revealed.
stoppingRule.failedRun: Count a model or tool failure as a first-pass failure unless an independently logged provider outage affected the run.

execution.agentVisibility: Each session receives the identical task prompt and only the files in its anonymous arm directory.
execution.runtimeVisibility: The evaluator may install the pinned public packages, but package JavaScript, repository source, playground code, git history, and other arms are not supplied to the agent.
execution.production: Run behavioral scoring against a production build.
execution.development: Run devtools recorder checks separately in a development build because the normal recorder is intentionally inert in production.

externalValidityArm.design: Run one additional unrestricted-network session per provider family and variant. Report it separately and never pool it with the primary result.

humanVisualGate.selection: After all run IDs are sealed, randomly select one completed build from every provider-family by arm stratum, balancing variants where possible.
humanVisualGate.blinding: Serve compiled builds under random IDs. Hide arm, provider, prompt transcript, source, prose comments, and automated score.
humanVisualGate.conditions: Use real input with DevTools and capture closed. Review capture only after the direct visual verdict.
criteria: push, pop, and swipe phase consistency

claimBoundary: Report results only for the pinned package, documentation, skill, task variants, provider families, and model versions in the run manifest.
